title: Hastings' Confessions: his own abduction experiences

tellings.quote: he wrote after UFOs and nukes is called confessions and it's about his own his personal experien abduction cases

Of course, as an abductee myself, who has repeatedly experienced the physical reality of these amazing encounters, I am admittedly biased about the prospect of this realization materializing sooner or later, among our species as a whole.

plain: The writer Robert Hastings, after his book UFOs and Nukes about UFOs at nuclear weapons sites, wrote a book called Confessions about his own experiences of being abducted, Michels says, telling it himself without further source. Hastings says it in his own words in an article published on 16 November 2025, "Ex-USAF Security Policeman Tells of Being Abducted by Aliens", calling himself "an abductee myself, who has repeatedly experienced the physical reality of these amazing encounters" and admitting he is "biased" as a result, which matters because the investigator collecting such accounts says he has lived them too.
